verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs list charts, dashboards, and insights as a core capability, include a 'Create a dashboard' guide, and describe spaces that organize charts, dashboards, and notebooks for the owning team. A Dashboard REST API also exposes dashboard data, so composing team-facing dashboards is clearly part of the product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of adding saved charts to a dashboard, explicit sharing and permission controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard workflow.
